_doc: Per-slug canonical override map for frontaliere-section blog articles. Same shape, same loader and same semantics as data/swiss-article-canonical-overrides.json (issue #3010 item 1) — the mechanism was hardwired to the svizzera section in ogPagesPlugin.ts and is now driven per section by shared/canonicalOverrideFiles.mjs. Key = page slug (last URL segment, no leading slash) of the shadowed (lower-authority) variant, one entry per locale. Value = absolute canonical URL of the authoritative/winner variant in the SAME locale. Both pages stay live (no removal, no noindex, no redirect — repo anti-cut rule): only the shadowed variant's <link rel="canonical"> and og:url point at the winner, and the shadowed URL is not advertised in a sitemap (a sitemap <loc> whose page canonicalises elsewhere is a hard CI gate failure — scripts/audit-sitemap-canonicals.mjs, scripts/validate-sitemap-pages.mjs). RSS is NOT touched, same as the svizzera precedent. This file lives inside packages/articles/engine/ on purpose: mirror-articles-engine.yml carries engine/** to the corpus repo that renders article pages, while scripts/pull-articles-corpus.mjs would delete a site-only file placed under packages/articles/content/. Source: three near-duplicate piastrellista guides published 2026-08-09 (11:30, 15:44 and 16:08 UTC); winner chosen by the owner.
